description: This file contains a unit test class for testing the AbstractLeaveAllocationService in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes test methods for adding hours to a time and calculating duration between two times, utilizing mock objects and data providers.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing methods of AbstractLeaveAllocationService in the context of leave management.

methods.name: testAddHoursDuration
methods.description: Tests the addHoursDuration method by verifying it correctly adds hours to a DateTime object.

methods.name: getAddHoursDurationDataProvider
methods.description: Provides sample data for testing addHoursDuration, including start time, hours to add, and expected result.

methods.name: testGetDurationInHours
methods.description: Tests the getDurationInHours method to verify correct calculation of hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: getDurationInHoursDataProvider
methods.description: Provides sample pairs of DateTime objects and expected duration in hours for testing getDurationInHours.
